card.name: Inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Pieces of words and small linking words inside long ALL-CAPS passages, such as boxed warnings. It fires on endings like ING or TH in LIFE-THREATENING, and on AND, BE, INCLUDING.

modes.label: Word pieces in caps
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of split capitalized words in a boxed warning.
modes.example: WARNING: ADDICTION, ABUSE, AND MISUSE; LIFE-THREATEN<<ING>> RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION; ACC

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: Short connecting words such as AND, BE or INCLUDING inside capitalized warning sentences.
modes.example: IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION OCCURS, BICILLIN C-R SHOULD<< BE>> DISCONTINUED AND APPROPRI

card.writes: It pushes capitalized continuations such as ITER, BMW and LINUX, which suggests all-caps text carries on.
card.plain: It marks words inside text written entirely in capital letters, like boxed warnings.
